query: How do reasons for visit relate to urgency and visit duration across department and age group?

per_column.name: visit_type
per_column.rationale: Categorizes the encounter (acute vs follow-up vs well-visit), a genuine axis to relate reasons to urgency/duration. Sample values are well-supported readings of the text.

per_column.name: primary_complaint_category
per_column.rationale: Directly operationalizes 'reasons for visit' into a groupable clinical category, central to the query. Samples map cleanly to source text.

per_column.name: acuity_temporal_pattern
per_column.rationale: Adds a temporal/acuity axis distinct from urgency, useful for relating to duration. Mostly grounded; the MI follow-up labeled post_procedural_followup is a slight stretch (MI is not strictly a procedure) but reasonable.

per_column.name: symptom_severity_level
per_column.rationale: An ordinal severity scale can correlate with urgency/duration, giving analytical leverage. However the numeric level is a subjective inference; many rows collapse to '2', and precise 1-5 values are only loosely warranted by the text.

per_column.name: clinical_mechanism_type
per_column.rationale: Provides a pathophysiologic axis orthogonal to complaint category, useful for modeling. Sample values are defensible readings, though somewhat inferential.

per_column.name: diagnostic_workup_intensity
per_column.rationale: Workup intensity plausibly drives visit duration, directly relevant to the query. Samples align with ordered labs/imaging described in the text.

per_column.name: disposition_action
per_column.rationale: Disposition relates to urgency and duration and offers a useful outcome axis. Sample values are grounded in prescriptions/referrals stated in the text.

per_column.name: preventive_or_screening_focus
per_column.rationale: Reasonable secondary axis but heavily dominated by 'none_preventive' (197), giving it near-constant character and limited leverage; partly redundant with visit_type/complaint_category. Values that are present are well-grounded.

judge.rationale: The added columns provide multiple genuinely distinct axes (complaint category, acuity pattern, workup intensity, disposition) that directly support relating reasons-for-visit to urgency and duration across strata. Most values are sound categorizations or clearly warranted inferences from the reason_for_visit text, with a reasonable 'none/not stated' default for silent rows. Weaknesses are minor: symptom_severity_level is a subjective numeric inference, and preventive_or_screening_focus is near-constant and somewhat redundant. No clear hallucinations observed in the samples.
